notes.title: NEW DEMO available, Soundtrack & more!
notes.content:
Hello all FLASHOUT fans!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif

After FLASHOUT 3 got released on Steam, we were mainly focused on making the whole experience more enjoyable, so we gathered the initial feedback and responded with a set of updates, that addressed some minor issues that came up after the release.

We fixed the issue with unresponsive controls on the Mac platform, we fixed a blocker in the last tournament, we updated the localization, did some sound and graphical fixes, but mainly we changed a bit the amounts of points that are required to unlock ships, circuit, weapons and upgrades in the game - now it should be much easier to achieve :). We also added EXP points to Time Trial - a much requested feature. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/d7497eacc9e2ee0940ca6cecd1972e25f07273a9.gif

These are however not all the small fixes that we introduced here and there - for details check out patch notes.

But we did not spot there. After lot of feedback, we also reworked a bit the tutorial - now it's focused only on the things you really need to know, so there are less frustrating pop-ups.

Last but not least, we updated the demo version to match the final version of the game. So if you still didn't buy the full game and you have doubts, the demo is available again, but now it shows you a bit more from the game - you can check out all the main gameplay modes available in FLASHOUT 3, so you can take part not only in a Standard race, but also in Destruction and Elimination modes. Of course the demo still incorporates VR support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985280

Another nice addition should be the Soundtrack which is now available via Steam and it features more than 50 minutes of electronic music composed especially for the game by renowned demoscene artists! 

Here's the full list of featured tunes:

Each week we try to share with you some news about FLASHOUT 3 and this one is no exception! But first we would like to thank you all for downloading FLASHOUT 3D: Enhanced Edition - we brought the classic racer, that launched 10 years ago, back for FREE and almost 100.000 players downloaded it during the first week. A huge thank you! 

However if you missed it, no worries, FLASHOUT 3D: Enhanced Edition is still there, so you can grab your copy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022780

Anyway let's get back to FLASHOUT 3, which is coming to Steam in less than 2 weeks. 2 weeks that for us mean a lot of work and polishing, but that's the way it is before each release ;). We have prepared a lot of stuff for you to enjoy in the game - 10 tournaments, 8 ships, 10 unique themed circuits in 2 versions each, VR, motion simulators support, and so much more!

We would also like to shed some light on the 2 characters you will find in FLASHOUT 3. So let's introduce you to Bea and Silas:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/7f0b12bb3222c21a9a424b1583a9c19d65c8e7f1.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/19741e854cf91f3169bc0e8b476eaa732a036081.gif

Wonder which character you will choose for your first campaign :). Also make sure to check out the updated description of the game to find out what you will find in FLASHOUT 3 as soon it launches on Steam!

Last but not least we didn't want to leave you without some stuff from the game. So here's a new gameplay video, this time featuring the Dark Moon circuit. It was inspired by our upcoming survival strategy game Dark Moon, which is being developed by our second team for quite some time. We are aware that many players and followers are looking forward to see something new from the game and we also do want to deliver new material asap - but as the game is very complex and we wanted to redesign some stuff and introduce new features to it, it just takes time. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105330/Dark_Moon/

In the case of the Dark Moon circuit the inspiration is quite obvious. While the story in Dark Moon is pretty detailed and we don't want to spoil to much, let's just say that in the not too distant future, humankind has developed the necessary means to retrieve the Moon’s valuable minerals with extreme efficiency. With the Outer Space Treaty still valid, nine nations have agreed to work together on the new space endeavor. To ensure the stability and security of this new international agreement an organization called Moon Shell was formed. And in FLASHOUT 3 you can admire some of the structures built by the Moon Shell organization.

We would also like to introduce you to one of the ships available in the game - Skyhopper. A pretty nice construction offering great speed at the price of weaker armor.

notes.title: FLASHOUT 3: F3D: Enhanced Edition, Split Screen & more!
notes.content:
Hello all FLASHOUT fans!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/d5bc1cecacf056cf0426c81cc909c9dd464bc0c2.gif

Today we have some really cool news to share with you! As you might already know, 10 years ago we have released the first game in the series - FLASHOUT 3D. Since it's the 10th anniversary of the first game and FLASHOUT 3 is coming this year, we wanted to celebrate these two facts with you. Especially that FLASHOUT 3D was never present on Steam - it was being sold in boxes (on DVD) and the digital version was limited to just a few online stores. The game was also present on the OUYA platform (well... you probably forgot that such console even existed - however FLASHOUT 3D and FLASHOUT 2 were one of the most popular games on this hardware) and on mobile devices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/bf4af24f9fa8d8ef869cb972372fe93b071ceef8.gif

Nevertheless, as we wrote above it was never present on Steam - an oversight that needs to be fixed. And we decided to fix it properly, so we took the classic, 10-years old game and remastered it a bit. Now FLASHOUT 3D offers updated graphics, full gamepad support (with vibrations), a new UI, better controls and much more! The great news is that we will offer FLASHOUT 3D: Enhanced Edition 100% FREE OF CHARGE! That's right, when the Enhanced Edition releases later this month (September 2 to be precise) it will be free! And of course no microtransactions, no sirs!

So if you don't want to miss this moment and would like to travel to the past and play one of classic AG racers, wishlist FLASHOUT 3D: Enhanced Edition now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022780

Now let's go back to FLASHOUT 3, shall we? :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif

First of all we would like to confirm that we are on track with the production and right now we are focused on polishing the Main Menu. Here's a small sneak peek of what we have come up this far, but it's still work in progress, so you will see the final version closer to the release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/a8403313f20dc824d340794ff018da45b331097e.gif

We have also told you, that we were planning to add a Split Screen mode allowing you to race against a friend or member of your family on one computer. We know this is a bit of a retro feature, but in our opinion a feature that is missed. So we can confirm that the Split Screen mode is ready and working like a charm! We also thought that it would be cool if you could choose if you want to split the screen horizontally or vertically. That's a pretty nice feature if you own an ultrawide monitor, giving you more horizontal space. So here's how it looks like:

Horizontal Split Screen (best choice for 16:9 monitors):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/a48edf68e81790ec56723985220e24224a4c0d7b.gif

Vertical Split Screen (best choice for 21:9 monitors and wider):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/8b6ab7dccab498c1ae6047dc473da89f87de0a52.gif

But obviously which Split Screen version you prefer to use on your setup is your call ;).

So that's all for today - we hope you are pleased with the news and more info is around the corner, so stay tuned for additional FLASHOUT 3 info in the upcoming weeks!

notes.title: FLASHOUT 3: Cockpit View and quick look at VR!
notes.content:
Hello all FLASHOUT fans!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif

Long time no see, but we were really busy during recent weeks. So it's time for a small update on the progress we have made with the development of the game. As you already know, we decided to add VR support and this required us to work on a few very important things. First of all we wanted to make sure that FLASHOUT 3 works on all popular VR headsets - so not only Oculus or HTC Vive, but also on such devices as headsets made by Pimax. This was quite important, because these devices give you a much better FOV and that's something really important in racers - especially in anti-gravity racers where the circuits can have pretty crazy layouts :).

Another important thing was to optimize the game. You need to render everything twice, thus the processing power required to achieve constant and acceptable framerates is quite higher, obviously. We managed to achieve really good results in this respect and the good news is that optimizations will also have a positive impact on the standard version of the game. So it's a win-win situation.

Last but not least we knew VR needs to be really immersive. So adding a cockpit view was a must. But it was a bigger challenge than some of you might expect, because once again - anti-gravity racers are quite different than ordinary racing games. Nevertheless here's what we came up with finally:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/c990912349505cdd55630a0b2451e745b51a3056.gif

There are two important things to mention here:

1. As you can see, in VR mode the GUI is working a bit like a HUD in a modern car. So we have moved all the information that was displayed on the screen to the cockpit. This way it's much easier to read all the info and it's, well... more cool :).

2. Because it's an anti-gravity racer, there are not only crazy loops and bends on the circuits, but also jumps and special actions that the player can perform - such as barrel rolls. And why this is a problem? The answer is quite simple - not only you need to have the possibility to look what is above you, but also what is laying below - because when you jump you want to know where to land. This is why in FLASHOUT 3 the cockpit is semi-opened. It means that you can see the main frame that holds the ship together, as well as your character (full body or hands and legs - depending on your choice), but you don't see the body of the ship. And it still makes sense, because in FLASHOUT 3 racers are using AR headsets during races, just like one of the main characters:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/c935a34b3967e46b1d0e04df3185d97dbd2d84d2.gif

It is also important to note that the VR version of FLASHOUT 3 will support keyboard and standard game controllers (gamepads, wheels, hotas). Since it's a racing game we have no plans to support dedicated VR controllers (they just don't offer you enough control in racing games).

Obviously since we brought the cockpit view to VR mode, it's also present in the standard version. We are still perfecting it, but we already have the possibility to change the camera view to cockpit view also in the standard (no-VR) version of the game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/4a80f3a6ff11ce3e4d4f6d9220f69ef5e8a5b362.gif

In the upcoming weeks we will show you a few new circuits and we also have some good news if you're more of a multiplayer kind of soul - we are currently working on split-screen multiplayer, a feature that is in our opinion missing in most racing games. The split-screen multiplayer will support two modes - vertical and horizontal split-screen. Pretty handy if you're a lucky owner of a widescreen monitor :).

And what about online multiplayer? Will see ;). 

Meanwhile you can still check out the demo version. We are planning to add VR mode to it on Monday, so stay tuned!

notes.title: FLASHOUT 3: Upcoming Circuits, Part 1
notes.content:
Hello all FLASHOUT fans!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif

We didn't want to leave you without some tasty FLASHOUT 3 news before the weekend begins...

So as promised, we want to shed some light on the upcoming circuits that you will find in FLASHOUT 3 :). When designing circuits our main goal was to make sure that each track gives you a totally different experience - both visually and gameplaywise. And of course, each circuit will feature a different music tune. While we plan to publish a few nice videos from the content we have prepeared, here is a small sneak peek of what's coming!

NEON PARADISE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/ffa3ea8984530a474f94e2f4af0f19ca60ab4ef3.gif

Actually Neon Paradise is the very first circuit that made it into the game. It wasn't the first track we had done - there were many of them, but we were not fully happy with the results and the experience they offered. We did a lot of experimentation and it was a "try & error" work for the most part - at least in the beginning of development. We needed to find out what works best with our physics engine and what kind of bends, curves, spins, angles, track sizes, etc. give the best gameplay experience. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/7e774425a5f57f68983fc85bba6316aca8419b06.gif

Neon Paradise is quite unique in the whole game, because it's a track that gives you the feeling of old classic arcade games, like Out Run or Chase HQ (if you still remember these awesome titles). It's also a hardcore circuit with tight curves and little time for reaction, so it requires some real skill to master :).

DARK MOON

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/1ce58e1e5818333a42aa4a8745a39fa108394ab3.gif

Dark Moon is a circuit that takes you into space, but not that far away from Earth. You will land on the Moon, where you will participate in an explosive and awesome race, that pays tribute to our upcoming game... Dark Moon. Btw - If you like strategy games don't hesitate to add this one to your Steam wishlist, as we feel it's going to be pretty great ;).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105330

This track is a quick one, but also one that gives you many opportunities to attack your opponents. And the game will offer you a real arsenal of weapons. What we have shown you in the demo version was just a peak of the iceberg. There's much more coming in the final game, so you will have the chance to work out your fighting strategy and to find out what works best for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/3f792346f7589807a47d394bfbfeca1d58c4b3ee.gif

And that's all for today folks! We hope you enjoy the new stuff we have shared and will have a great weekend! We have much more up our sleeves, so make sure you wishlist the game and stay tuned for more FLASHOUT 3 news! Also (if you didn't) don't forget to check out the demo version.
